description: Start a session of work and, if none is running, the timer. Returns a verdict: ok | stop | plan_first. On "stop" NO session is created: relay the message, ask the user; if they insist, call again with override=true. Several sessions may run at once (two terminals) and share attention by weight.

direction.description: up (default) counts elapsed time and runs until stopped, with a stand-up reminder every workMin; down is a fixed timebox, for a break

exclusive.description: true: nothing else was happening then

minutes.description: length for a down timer, or the stand-up interval for an up timer

override.description: true only after the user confirmed past a stop

task.description: what you are about to do, specific

weight.description: attention weight vs other sessions at the same time, default 1

name: start_session
title: Start session
